ideas.pitch: An agent built on the event-provided SDK that rapidly introspects unfamiliar API endpoints, writes missing unit tests, catches breaking contracts, and auto-corrects integration errors.
ideas.problem_statement: Autopilot: Build an Agent. Give It a Mission. Let It Take Over (Agonthon challenge focused on autonomous task execution via a custom SDK and automated judging system)
ideas.title: Autonomous API Diagnostic and Self-Healing Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since automated judging systems evaluate your agent against black-box constraints on a leaderboard, building a robust error-recovery and state-checking loop will maximize passing test cases.

ideas.pitch: A structured orchestration agent using a multi-agent graph architecture to delegate tasks, synthesize external unstructured data, and generate verifiable final execution payloads.

ideas.title: Modular Multi-Role Chief of Staff Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Automated scoring systems favor modular agents with distinct planning, execution, and verification phases over single monolithic LLM prompts.
